posts.text: An ICE agent already charged in Minnesota for state crime is charged by the DOJ in federal court. Christian Castro is wanted in Minnesota for State crimes commit during an immigration enforcement operation, but now Trump’s Department of justice charged him with lying to federal investigators, also. This could be a case of pursuit of justice, but might also provide Castro with a path to freedom.

posts.text: The USPS has approved a rule at Trump‘s request that would allow the post office to refuse to deliver potentially tens of thousands of ballots if a single ballot in a batch does not pass verification of compliance with federal ballot rules.  Under the new rule, the post office will test samples from the full batches sent by the states and will reject the entire batch if a single sample ballot fails.

posts.text: A town in Oklahoma tried to charge $17,000 to provide a local farmer with documents and records about his arrest at a Townhall meeting on data center construction. Daren Blanchard was arrested when he went 30 seconds over his allotted time. He pleaded not guilty and asked for public records and body cam footage. The city tried to charge him $17,000 for those records, but the state of Oklahoma called that some unlawful.
